'''Pat Henderson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2001 Connecticut tournament]] on 19 May 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM]], according to Mike Gemme's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2338">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-21-tatooine-spoiler-tourney-5-19-ctd2338/ tatooine-spoiler-tourney-5-19-ct], DeckTech (michael "Deck" Gemme, 21 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-21-tatooine-spoiler-tourney-5-19-ctd2338/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
